latestVersion.changelog:
veo-video-gen 1.0.7

- Added a critical warning to never alter any API response values (such as task_id, result_urls, image_url, upload_url, or fields): always use them exactly as returned from the API to avoid errors or broken links.
- Emphasized storing and passing API response tokens verbatim in all example workflows and instructions for both text-to-video and image-to-video tasks.
- No changes to code or implementation; documentation and usage guidance update only.
